claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: ZD-7114 is a beta3-adrenoceptor agonist that modulates cAMP/cGMP signaling and fibroblast proliferation but has no described cytotoxic mechanism, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive rather than broadly cytotoxic.
